# assistant turns and JSON structure, which are ASCII-heavy and would skew to English).
detect_lang() {
  command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo en; return; }
  python3 - "$CONFIG_DIR/projects" 2>/dev/null <<'PY' || echo en
import sys, os, glob, json
base = sys.argv[1]
try:
    files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "**", "*.jsonl"), recursive=True),
                   key=os.path.getmtime, reverse=True)[:20]
except Exception:
    files = []
# Vote per message (presence of script), not per char ??so a few large ASCII
# pastes (code, logs, specs) don't drown out many short typed Korean turns.
ko = ja = en = 0
msgs = 0
def vote(s):
    global ko, ja, en, msgs
    hk = hj = hl = False
    for ch in s:
        o = ord(ch)
        if 0xAC00 <= o <= 0xD7A3: hk = True
        elif 0x3040 <= o <= 0x30FF: hj = True
        elif 65 <= o <= 90 or 97 <= o <= 122: hl = True
    if hk: ko += 1
    elif hj: ja += 1
    elif hl: en += 1
    if hk or hj or hl: msgs += 1
for f in files:
    if msgs >= 400: break
    try:
        fh = open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    except Exception:
        continue
    for line in fh:
        if msgs >= 400: break
        try:
            m = json.loads(line).get("message")
        except Exception:
            continue
        if not isinstance(m, dict) or m.get("role") != "user":
            continue
        c = m.get("content")
        if isinstance(c, str):
            vote(c)
        elif isinstance(c, list):
            for part in c:
                if isinstance(part, dict) and part.get("type") == "text":
                    vote(part.get("text", ""))
    fh.close()
if ko and ko >= ja and ko >= en: print("ko")
elif ja and ja >= ko and ja >= en: print("ja")
else: print("en")
PY
}

# --- record the star decision (and star the repos on "yes") ---
write_star() {  # $1 = decision (yes|no|asked)
  ts=$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  printf '{"star_decision":"%s","plugin":"%s","ts":%s}\n' "$1" "$PLUGIN" "$ts" > "$STAR_MARKER"
}

if [ "${1:-}" = "star" ]; then
  DECISION="${2:-no}"
  write_star "$DECISION"
  if [ "$DECISION" = "yes" ] && command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    for repo in "$OWN_REPO" "$HUB_REPO"; do
      gh api "user/starred/$repo" >/dev/null 2>&1 || gh api -X PUT "user/starred/$repo" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    done
  fi
  exit 0


"}

def fetch(
    url: str,
    *,
    success_selectors: Optional[list[str]] = None,
    device_class: str = "auto",
    user_hint: Optional[dict] = None,
    timeout: int = 25,
    max_attempts: Optional[int] = None,
    max_browser_attempts: int = 2,
    enable_playwright: bool = True,
    enable_phase0: bool = True,
    enable_learning: bool = True,
    enable_extraction: bool = True,
    enable_retry: bool = True,
    enable_markdown: bool = True,
    enable_maincontent: bool = False,
) -> FetchResult:
    """Public entrypoint ??the generic grid wrapped with per-host self-learning.

    1. Before fetching, look up the route that last succeeded for this host and
       promote it: it becomes the probe identity AND the front of the grid.
    2. After fetching, record the winning route; or, if a learned route was
       promoted and the run hit a REAL block, strike it (evicted after two
       consecutive strikes ??see `learning.py`).

    The store is a bounded, self-pruning JSON file; any error in it is swallowed
    so learning can never break a fetch. Disable per-call with
    ``enable_learning=False`` or globally with ``INSANE_LEARN=0``.

    ``enable_extraction`` (default True) turns on content-rescue extraction:
    PDF bodies come back as pypdf-extracted text, and thin SPA shells fall back
    to JSON-LD articleBody / rendered innerText. Ordinary HTML successes keep
    the raw body ??check ``FetchResult.extraction_source`` ("raw" = untouched).

    ``enable_retry`` (default True) retries transient statuses (429/502/503/
    504) on the PROBE attempt with exponential backoff, honouring a numeric
    ``Retry-After``. Grid attempts never retry ??a failing grid must not
    multiply sleeps across dozens of candidates.

    ``enable_markdown`` (default True) converts a raw-HTML success to
    structure-preserving markdown via markdownify (tables ??pipe tables,
    <pre>/<code> ??fences); ``extraction_source`` becomes "raw+md". Set False
    for raw HTML. No-op when markdownify is not installed.
    ``enable_maincontent`` (opt-in) instead strips boilerplate via resiliparse."""
    priority: Optional[dict] = None

+"""Archive public Korean Coupang API docs using insane-search, then audit coverage."""
+import concurrent.futures as cf
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+import sys
+import time
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit, unquote
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT = HERE.parents[1] / 'docs/api'
+sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent / 'insane-search/skills/insane-search'))
+from engine import fetch
+from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
+from markdownify import markdownify
+from curl_cffi import requests
+
+BASE = 'https://developers.coupang.com'
+START = BASE + '/ko/api'
+ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+def dump(path, obj):
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
+
+def normalized(url, base=START):
+    p = urlsplit(urljoin(base, url))
+    return p.scheme + '://' + p.netloc + p.path.rstrip('/')
+
+def in_scope(url):
+    p = urlsplit(url)
+    return p.netloc == 'developers.coupang.com' and any(p.path == x or p.path.startswith(x + '/') for x in ['/ko/api', '/ko/getting-started', '/ko/workflows', '/ko/faq'])
+
+def paths(url):
+    rel = urlsplit(url).path.lstrip('/')
+    return ROOT / 'html' / (rel + '.html'), ROOT / 'markdown' / (rel + '.md')
+
+def links(html, url):
+    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')
+    return {normalized(a['href'], url) for a in soup.select('a[href]') if in_scope(normalized(a['href'], url))}
+
+def collect(url, refresh=False):
+    raw, md = paths(url)
+    meta = ROOT / 'metadata' / (urlsplit(url).path.lstrip('/') + '.json')
+    if raw.exists() and md.exists() and meta.exists() and not refresh:
+        return json.loads(meta.read_text(encoding='utf-8')), links(raw.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), url)
+    result = fetch(url, enable_markdown=False, enable_extraction=False, success_selectors=['main h1'], timeout=25)
+    soup = BeautifulSoup(result.content, 'html.parser')
+    main = soup.select_one('main')
+    if not result.ok or main is None or main.select_one('h1') is None or len(main.get_text(strip=True)) < 40:
+        raise RuntimeError(f'{url}: {result.verdict} {result.summary}')
+    title = main.select_one('h1').get_text(' ', strip=True)
+    raw.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    raw.write_text(result.content, encoding='utf-8')
+    for a in main.select('a[href]'):
+        a['href'] = urljoin(url, a['href'])
+    for a in main.select('img[src]'):
+        a['src'] = urljoin(url, a['src'])
+    for tag in main.select('script,style'):
+        tag.decompose()
+    text = markdownify(str(main), heading_style='ATX', code_language='').strip()
+    md.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    md.write_text(f'<!-- Source: {url} -->\n\n{text}\n', encoding='utf-8')
+    record = dict(url=url, final_url=result.final_url, title=title, fetched_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), html=str(raw.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'), markdown=str(md.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), bytes=raw.stat().st_size, main_chars=len(main.get_text()), tables=len(main.select('table')), code_blocks=len(main.select('pre')), verdict=result.verdict, extraction_source=result.extraction_source, trace=[vars(a) for a in result.trace])
+    dump(meta, record)
+    return record, links(result.content, url)
+
+def resource(url):
+    r = requests.get(url, impersonate='safari', timeout=30)
+    r.raise_for_status()
+    return r
+
+def main():
+    seed_text = (HERE.parents[1] / '명령수행.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
+    reference = links(seed_text[seed_text.find('<!DOCTYPE html>'):], START)
+    known = {START} | reference
+    sources = {}
+    for path in ['/robots.txt', '/sitemap.xml']:
+        try:

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from curl_cffi import requests
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
soup = BeautifulSoup((HERE / 'probe.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8'), 'html.parser')
print('INDEX ROWS', len(soup.select('main tbody tr')))
print('NAV LINKS', [(a.get_text(' ',strip=True), a['href']) for a in soup.select('aside a[href]')])
out = HERE / 'catalog-scripts'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for el in soup.select('script[src]'):
    src = el['src']
    if '/resources/' not in src:
        continue
    r = requests.get(urljoin('https://developers.coupang.com', src), impersonate='safari', timeout=25)
    if r.status_code == 200:
        (out / src.split('/')[-1]).write_bytes(r.content)
        strings = re.findall(r'["\']([^"\']{1,200})["\']', r.text)
        print(src, len(r.content), [s for s in strings if re.search('json|search|openapi|swagger|/api/', s, re.I)][:70])

"""Independent coverage and content checks on the saved archive."""
import json
import hashlib
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'docs/api'
docs = json.loads((ROOT/'search-index.ko.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['documents']
expected = {'https://developers.coupang.com'+d['url'] for d in docs if d['url'].startswith('/ko/api/')}
records = [json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in (ROOT/'metadata').rglob('*.json')]
saved = {r['url'] for r in records}
issues=[]
for r in records:
    html=(ROOT/r['html']).read_bytes()
    soup=BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')
    main=soup.select_one('main')
    md=(ROOT/r['markdown']).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    if hashlib.sha256(html).hexdigest()!=r['sha256']: issues.append([r['url'],'hash'])
    if r['title'] not in md: issues.append([r['url'],'title'])
    # Ensure every example code block survives conversion, including Unicode.
    for pre in main.select('pre'):
        code=pre.get_text().strip().replace('\r\n','\n')
        if code and code not in md: issues.append([r['url'],'code block differs'])
report=dict(search_document_types=dict(Counter(d['type'] for d in docs)), expected_api_documents=len(expected), saved_api_documents=len(expected & saved), missing_api_documents=sorted(expected-saved), total_saved=len(saved), integrity_issues=issues)
(ROOT/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=True,indent=2))

## 상세

**API 적용 가능한 구매자 사용자 지역: 한국**

판매자ID가 현재 카테고리 자동매칭 서비스에 동의했는지 체크합니다.

카테고리 자동매칭 서비스에 대한 자세한 내용은 [여기](https://developers.coupang.com/ko/getting-started/category-auto-matching-service-information)를 참고해주세요.

※ 1개의 사업자 번호로 입점하신 판매자님은 해당 API를 사용할 필요 없이, 동의 버튼 1회 클릭으로 카테고리 자동 매칭 서비스를 이용하실 수 있습니다.

```
※ 카테고리 자동매칭 서비스 동의 경로  
판매관리시스템(WING) 로그인 > 우측상단 업체명 클릭 > 추가판매정보 클릭
```

## Path

GET

/v2/providers/seller\_api/apis/api/v1/marketplace/vendors/{vendorId}/check-auto-category-agreed

### Example Endpoint

https://api-gateway.coupang.com/v2/providers/seller\_api/apis/api/v1/marketplace/vendors/A00123456/check-auto-category-agreed

## Request Parameters

### Path Segment Parameter

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| vendorId\* | String | 판매자ID (=업체코드) |

### Request Example

not require body

## Response Message

| Name | | | | | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code | | | | | String | SUCCESS/ERROR |
| message | | | | | String | 메세지 |
| data | | | | | String | 동의여부  true or false |

### Response Example

```
{
    "code": "SUCCESS",
    "message": "",
    "data": true
}
```

### Error Spec

| HTTP 상태 코드(오류 유형) | 오류 메시지 | 해결 방법 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 400 (요청변수확인) | 업체[A00123456]는 다른 업체[A0012\*\*\*]의 정보을 검색 수 없습니다. | 올바른 판매자ID를 입력했는지 확인합니다. |

"""Create offline linked Markdown while preserving preformatted examples exactly."""
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from markdownify import MarkdownConverter

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'docs/api'

def pre_text(el):
    clone = BeautifulSoup(str(el), 'html.parser').select_one('pre')
    for br in clone.select('br'):
        br.replace_with('\n')
    return clone.get_text().replace('\r\n', '\n').strip('\n')

class Converter(MarkdownConverter):
    def convert_pre(self, el, text, parent_tags):
        text = pre_text(el)
        longest = max((len(m.group()) for m in re.finditer(r'`+', text)), default=0)
        fence = '`' * max(3, longest + 1)
        return '\n\n' + fence + '\n' + text + '\n' + fence + '\n\n'

def main():
    records = json.loads((ROOT/'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    lookup = {r['url']: ROOT/r['markdown'] for r in records}
    assets = json.loads((ROOT/'assets.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    lookup.update({a['url']: ROOT/a['file'] for a in assets if 'file' in a})
    for r in records:
        soup = BeautifulSoup((ROOT/r['html']).read_text(encoding='utf-8'), 'html.parser')
        main = soup.select_one('main')
        dest = ROOT/r['markdown']
        for el in main.select('a[href],img[src]'):
            attr = 'href' if el.name == 'a' else 'src'
            absolute = urljoin(r['url'], el[attr])
            parsed = urlsplit(absolute)
            nofrag = absolute.split('#')[0].rstrip('/')
            if nofrag in lookup:
                el[attr] = os.path.relpath(lookup[nofrag], dest.parent).replace('\\','/') + ('#'+parsed.fragment if parsed.fragment else '')
            else:
                el[attr] = absolute
        for el in main.select('script,style'):
            el.decompose()
        text = Converter(heading_style='ATX').convert(str(main)).strip()
        dest.write_text(f'<!-- Source: {r["url"]} -->\n\n{text}\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(f'Exported {len(records)} offline-linked Markdown documents.')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import json,re,hashlib
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from export_markdown import ROOT,pre_text
report=json.loads((ROOT/'verification.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
manifest=json.loads((ROOT/'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
urls={url for url,issue in report['integrity_issues'] if issue=='code block differs'}
for r in manifest:
    md=ROOT/r['markdown']
    if r['url'] in urls:
        soup=BeautifulSoup((ROOT/r['html']).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'html.parser')
        text=md.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        for pre in soup.select('main pre'):
            code=pre_text(pre)
            if code and code not in text:
                fence='`'*max(3,1+max((len(m.group()) for m in re.finditer(r'`+',code)),default=0))
                text+='\n\n## 표 안의 코드 원문\n\n'+fence+'\n'+code+'\n'+fence+'\n'
        md.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
    r['markdown_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(md.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    r['markdown_bytes']=md.stat().st_size
(ROOT/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print('Preserved multiline table examples in',len(urls),'documents.')
